name: SetActiveExcelWorksheet
label: Set Active Excel Worksheet
description: Activates a specific worksheet in the provided Excel workbook by name or index and outputs the active worksheet instance.

fields.name: WorkbookInstance
fields.label: Workbook Instance
fields.description: The Excel Workbook object containing the target worksheets.

fields.name: SelectionType
fields.label: Selection Type
fields.description: Choose whether to select the worksheet by Name or Index.

fields.name: SearchValue
fields.label: Search Value
fields.description: The worksheet name (if selection type is 'Name') or index (if selection type is 'Index').

fields.name: WorksheetInstance
fields.label: Worksheet Instance
fields.description: Returns the activated Excel Worksheet instance.
